name: claude-code-panel
description: A side panel and status bar for Claude Code in VS Code and Cursor: quota, current activity, task progress, context and token usage. Reads local files; no telemetry.
author: karin-lin

commands.title: Claude Code Panel: Set up quota
Claude Code Panel: Install statusline helper
Claude Code Panel: Uninstall statusline helper

claudeCodePanel.claudeDir.markdownDescription: Claude Code config directory. Empty means `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude`.

claudeCodePanel.pollSeconds.description: How often to re-read local files (seconds). No network involved.

claudeCodePanel.contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens, used for the percentage. Grows automatically to 1M if a request exceeds it.

enumDescriptions: Read a local JSON file (statusline helper or your own script)
Call Anthropic's usage endpoint with your Claude Code login (network)
claudeCodePanel.quota.source.description: Where the 5-hour / weekly quota numbers come from.

claudeCodePanel.quota.file.markdownDescription: JSON file to read when source is `file`. Empty means the statusline helper's output under the Claude config dir. See docs/CUSTOMIZING.md for the accepted formats.

claudeCodePanel.quota.apiIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between usage endpoint requests when source is `api`.

claudeCodePanel.quota.lines.markdownDescription: Optional personal limit lines, e.g. `{ "five_hour": 65, "seven_day": 70 }`. Draws a tick and counts the distance to it.

claudeCodePanel.progressFiles.markdownDescription: Extra progress files or folders (JSON). See docs/CUSTOMIZING.md.
